report.title: PLS-CADD .cri cable tension limits imported ~10x too small (1042 read as N): DS sags 3.6x too slack, short spans
report.detail:
PLS-CADD criteria (.cri, SI) cable tension limits are translated into DS Grid criterion rules about 10x too small, which makes every DS sag ~3.6x too slack and drives short spans and false clearance shortfalls.

Source: Gisagara Model 1 original backup (pls-original-workspace.bak -> Gisagararev7.bak member C:\Gisagararev3\Gisagararev3.cri, TYPE='CRI FILE' VERSION='94' UNITS='SI' PLS-CADD 16.81). Section "; cable_tension1" (16 rows) reads e.g. `I 0 'EDT' 1042 0`, `I 0 'High wind' 1042 0`, `I 0 'Maximum Conductor Temperature' 1042 0`, `I 0 'Minimum Temperature' 1042 0`, then rows at 1250 and 1656. Section "; autosag1" holds the catenary limits EDT 700, Minimum Temperature 840, High wind 1120, Maximum Conductor Temperature 560.

DS rules on the derived Model 3 criterion set criterion-set-0fb6e5cdbcf27437: horizontal_tension_ceiling_n = 1042.0 (High wind, Max temp, Min temp; initial) next to catenary_constant_m 700/840/1120/560. The planner then resolves rule ...-1 (1042 N) as governing: EDT initial C = 149.7 m, H = 414 N; 75 C after-creep C = 138.4 m.

Contradiction proving the unit: Model 1's own PLS AutoSag result (same conductor ACSR 70/12, w = 2.714 N/m) is C = 520-600 m at EDT initial (median 539 m), i.e. H ~ 1460 N, which a 1042 N ceiling forbids. With the ceiling read as 1042 daN (10420 N, ~40 % RTS of 26.27 kN) the catenary limits govern and the DS planner reproduces Model 1: EDT C = 541.1 m, H = 1497 N, governing rule = Minimum Temperature 840 m (verified on a Model 3 working copy by update_criterion_rule 1042 -> 10420; plan spans 35-65 m, clearance margins positive).

Expected: the PLS-CADD -> DS Grid criteria translation reads the cable-tension limit units exactly as PLS-CADD interprets them for UNITS='SI' (evidence says daN, or the column is not newtons), and the rows at 1250/1656 and the EDT row are carried too. Do not patch native bytes; correct the translation and re-derive.

Negative control: catenary_constant_m rules (700/840/1120/560 m) are correct today and must stay unchanged; a .cri with genuinely low N limits must still govern.

Acceptance: importing Gisagararev3.bak yields tension ceilings that, with the same catenary limits, reproduce Model 1's native AutoSag C (~540 m EDT initial) within tolerance; Model 3 planning on the derived criteria no longer caps sag at C ~150 m. No code from this session.
